verdict_text: NO. The merge formula in the script computes a sequential interpolation (`tmp = base + λ(ft1−base)`; `out = tmp + λ(ft2−tmp)`), which expands to `(1−λ)²·base + λ(1−λ)·ft1 + λ·ft2`, not the specified `base + λ(ft1−base) + λ(ft2−base) = (1−2λ)·base + λ·ft1 + λ·ft2`. With λ=0.4 these give base coefficients 0.36 vs 0.2 respectively — a materially different result, violating the "Required result" step 2 formula. This will fail the grading script's 1e-5 relative-error tolerance on the 48 merged tensors.
expected_defect: Task vector 2 is computed against the base after task vector 1 has already been added, so the second delta is taken from the wrong reference point.
